name: list_sublevels
purpose: Enumerate every streaming level of the open world with load/visibility state; also reports whether the world is partitioned.
cooked: works — reads in-memory world state; reports flattened persistent-level reality

name: add_sublevel
purpose: Add an existing level package to the open world as a streaming sublevel with optional transform.
cooked: refuses — .pak-mounted level packages have no loose .umap; works for new_level/save_level_as levels
hazards: MODAL FSuppressableWarningDialog if package already present/persistent (EditorLevelUtils.cpp:441-451)
MUST pre-check FLevelUtils::FindStreamingLevel and return alreadyPresent without calling engine
FScopedSlowTask progress dialog during synchronous level load (progress-only, safe)

name: create_sublevel
purpose: Create a brand-new empty streaming level in the open world and save it to a package path in one call, no SaveAs dialog.
cooked: n/a — always creates loose content; refuses paths resolving into mounted containers
hazards: MODAL SaveAs if bInUseSaveAs true — handler must hard-code false (EditorLevelUtils.cpp:760-767)
Deactivates active editor modes on entry, reactivates default on exit — report editorModeReset:true

name: remove_sublevel
purpose: Detach a streaming sublevel from the open world (asset stays on disk) — inverse of add_sublevel.
cooked: works — removes whatever list_sublevels shows; asset untouched
hazards: Engine resets undo buffer and runs GEditor->Cleanse (forced GC) — must run untransacted
MODAL FMessageDialog on locked level — pre-check FLevelUtils::IsLevelLocked (cpp:830-834)
MODAL FMessageDialog if package unload fails — check Package->IsDirty() first (cpp:894-897)

name: set_sublevel_visibility
purpose: Show/hide a sublevel in the editor viewport and set runtime loaded/visible flags; lighting-scenario workflows.
cooked: works — operates on in-memory streaming levels regardless of origin

name: set_current_sublevel
purpose: Route all subsequent spawn output into a chosen sublevel; without it everything lands in the persistent level.
cooked: works — in-memory
hazards: MODAL FMessageDialog inside MakeLevelCurrent on locked level (EditorLevelUtils.cpp:555-589)
MUST pre-check FLevelUtils::IsLevelLocked and return structured error, never hit dialog branch

name: move_actors_to_sublevel
purpose: Rehome existing placed actors into a sublevel with a numeric moved/failed report.
cooked: degraded — in-memory move works but cooked source world cannot be saved (warning field)
hazards: MUST pass bWarnAboutReferences=false and bWarnAboutRenaming=false — both true pop MODAL dialogs
Cut+paste-rename destroys/recreates actors — old actor paths die; response must return new paths
Mutates the editor selection as a side effect — report selectionChanged:true

name: set_sublevel_streaming
purpose: Change a sublevel's streaming class (always-loaded vs dynamic) and its level transform without re-adding the level.
cooked: degraded — in-memory works; cooked world cannot be saved
hazards: SetStreamingClassForLevel REPLACES the ULevelStreaming object — report old/new object paths
CRASH: check(Level) hard assert on unloaded sublevel (cpp:524-525) — pre-check GetLoadedLevel()!=nullptr

name: apply_spline_to_landscape
purpose: Deform (and optionally paint) the landscape along any existing USplineComponent — road/river bed from an authored spline.
cooked: degraded — works on loose landscapes; edits cooked IslaSombra in memory only, cannot save
prevents: Town-road gap documented in docs/08_LANDSCAPE.md (road-kit workaround) and docs/07_TOWN_BUILD_PLAN.md
hazards: PaintLayer not configured on landscape → engine silently does nothing — pre-check ULandscapeInfo::Layers
CRASH: unguarded LandscapeActor deref when no registered ULandscapeInfo (LandscapeBlueprintSupport.cpp:19-44)
Layers-enabled landscape with unresolved EditLayerName silently returns without deforming (cpp:26-31)
Null LandscapeActor (proxy-only WP landscape) silently no-ops — detect and report

name: create_landscape_spline
purpose: Author a real landscape spline (control points + segments) from a world-space point list — the native roads/rivers primitive.
cooked: degraded — works on loose landscapes; in-memory only on the cooked map
hazards: Relies on vtable dispatch of unexported public virtuals (UpdateSplinePoints etc.) — needs WITH_EDITOR parity
UpdateSplinePoints with bUpdateCollision=true only on the final pass, false while iterating

name: list_landscape_splines
purpose: Read back every landscape-spline control point and segment — verification read for create_landscape_spline.
cooked: works — if cooked world stripped spline editor data, report splineComponent:null honestly
hazards: GetSplineActors sits inside #if WITH_EDITOR (LandscapeInfo.h:438) — guard call site

name: apply_landscape_splines
purpose: Rasterise all landscape splines into heightmap/weightmaps (the Deform Landscape to Splines button).
cooked: degraded — in-memory caveat as every landscape mutation on the cooked map

name: export_heightmap
purpose: Dump landscape height data (whole extent or window) to a 16-bit file for numeric inspection/diff.
cooked: works — height data is live in the loaded world; fully useful on base-game terrain
hazards: REFUSE windows over 4033x4033 rather than blocking the frame

name: import_heightmap
purpose: Push a 16-bit heightmap file onto an existing landscape region — round-trip partner of export_heightmap.
cooked: degraded — in-memory only on cooked map (warning field), full on loose landscapes
hazards: Same 4033x4033 window cap as export_heightmap
8-bit PNG input must be rejected — quantises to 256 levels (visible terracing)

name: export_weightmap
purpose: Dump a paint layer's weights (0-255) to an 8-bit PNG — numerically verifies paint/spline corridors.
cooked: works — read-only against the cooked landscape

name: paint_foliage
purpose: Add instances to the real foliage system (AInstancedFoliageActor + FFoliageInfo) for a UFoliageType.
cooked: degraded — cooked UFoliageType assets load fine; placing into cooked persistent level is in-memory only
prevents: Existing add_foliage_instances builds a detached HISM holder invisible to foliage tools and procedural systems
hazards: Cap instances per call at 10000 (one HISM rebuild); larger sets batched by caller
Scatter traces that miss ground must be skipped and reported, never placed at trace origin

name: list_foliage
purpose: Enumerate foliage types present in the world with instance counts — the reader that makes foliage mutations verifiable.
cooked: degraded — types + component counts only; FFoliageInfo::Instances stripped from cooked packages
hazards: Instances is WITH_EDITORONLY_DATA and empty on .pak IFAs — take counts via FFoliageInfo::GetComponent()->GetInstanceCount()
Report countSource per type; area filter unsupported for cooked IFAs — report honestly

name: remove_foliage_instances
purpose: Delete foliage instances by type and/or area — clearing a building footprint before placement.
cooked: refuses — cooked foliage instances carry no editor instance data; only session-painted foliage removable
hazards: all:true without area wipes the whole type — deliberate two-key confirmation required
RebuildFoliageTree=true once per type after the last removal, not per instance

name: create_foliage_type
purpose: Author a UFoliageType_InstancedStaticMesh asset (density/scale/alignment rules around a mesh) as a reusable brush.
cooked: n/a — creates loose assets only; the mesh may come from cooked content (works)

name: resimulate_procedural_foliage
purpose: Run a procedural foliage simulation and spawn its instances into the world — biome-scale vegetation from one call.
cooked: degraded — pak spawner assets load; instances land in editable levels (cooked-save warning if targeting cooked level)
hazards: Simulate(-1) runs to convergence, can take seconds — hard step cap numSteps<=20 (default 10)
Simulate drives FScopedSlowTask-style long work on the game thread — keep the cap conservative

name: set_water_body_profile
purpose: Set per-point water parameters (depth, river width, flow velocity) living in UWaterSplineMetadata curves.
cooked: degraded — cooked-level water bodies editable in memory only; new bodies in mod levels fully work
hazards: AWaterBody UCLASS is Abstract — actorPath must resolve to a concrete River/Lake/Ocean/Custom subclass
Whether spawned water bodies render without a pre-existing AWaterZone is UNVERIFIED — open WaterZoneActor.h first
widths on a non-river body must ERROR, never silently ignore (RiverWidth is rivers-only)

name: build_reflection_captures
purpose: Recapture every reflection capture in the world after geometry/lighting changes; reports capture count.
cooked: works — captures live in the loaded world; cooked map cannot persist the result (warning)
hazards: FinishAllCompilation is an unbounded blocking wait — MANDATORY refuse while any shader/asset compile in flight
CRASH: check() hard assert below SM5 feature level (EditorEngine.cpp:3989) — pre-check and refuse
Slow-synchronous: flushes rendering and reads back every capture on the game thread

name: list_data_layers
purpose: Read-only census of World Partition data layers (name, runtime state, visibility) in the open world.
cooked: works — and is the point: reads live instances on the cooked WP IslaSombra

name: create_grass_type
purpose: Author a ULandscapeGrassType asset (mesh + density + placement rules) so scratch-landscape materials can emit grass.
cooked: n/a — creates loose assets; useless against cooked materials (material axis's problem, noted in response)
hazards: FGrassVariety ctor is non-inline and unexported (LandscapeGrass.cpp:1948) — direct array append will not link
Add elements via reflection: FArrayProperty + FScriptArrayHelper::AddValue, then set fields via reflection

name: create_level_instance
purpose: Pack a set of placed actors into a Level Instance (reusable sub-level actor, the modern prefab).
cooked: degraded — cooked source actors flagged sourcesCooked:true but proceed; new level is loose
hazards: BLOCKED: CreateLevelInstanceFrom hard-codes bUseSaveAs=true — MODAL Save-As dialog, deadlock mid-HTTP
No dialog-free exported path found in 5.3.2; revisit on 5.4+ or bridge-side reimplementation
